scope: All 44 mapped Chevalier-Montrachet parcels in Puligny-Montrachet independently reviewed for Tier 1 and #461. Named areas and commune edges audited. Source-specific history, sales and notice coverage retained; no current farmer verified. Producer research remains Tier 2.

accessGaps: Cadastral named areas are reviewed. The cru name also identifies a smaller constituent, so white wines retain the whole-cru INAO outline. No producer holding is inferred.
Producer and company-filing investigations remain Tier 2. Paid SPF copies and outreach remain Tier 3.
Source boundaries, failed notice downloads and unsearched intervals are reported in the history coverage; none means no historical record.
Current farming remains unconfirmed for every parcel.
